profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Fidelity Investments
profile.summary:
Proven technology enthusiast with over 14 years experience in building web based solutions.
Dedication about creating solutions that provide best User Experience and implement industry standard software engineering practices.
Extensive experience in the following areas:
- Agile Software Development
- Object Oriented Principals
- Implementation of automation using CI/CD
- .NET and Java based technologies
- Front end development with frameworks like AngularJS and jQuery
- Well versed in Web Design using HTML5, CSS3 and Bootstrap
- Relational and NoSQL databases
- Ability to adapt to fast changing environment

company.name: Wells Fargo Home Mortgage (At Robert Gatto & Associates Ltd)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Red Bank, New Jersey, United States

positions.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst/ Tech Lead
positions.description:
-	Introduced jQuery framework in application to implement client-side features.
-	Developed business logic in C# to create database driven UI using dynamic controls.
-	Responsible of web application rollouts in production and UAT environments.
-	Used third-party ComponentOne Enterprise Studio WebReport library to create PDF.
-	Responsible for resolving production issues.
-	Integrated Netegrity Siteminder Single-sign-on solution into ASP.NET based web application for Authentication.
-	For version control and sharing file utilized MS Visual Source-safe.
-	Re-designed and developed Dashboard in Adobe Flex to display various Call Center KPIs.
-	Developed console application for sending survey emails to Customer Service Representative and Supervisors.
-	Migrated application from ASP.NET 2.0 to ASP.NET MVC framework.
-	Developed web services using WCF to provide Call Center quality assurance information to be used by different applications across Verizon Wireless.

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description:
	Performed User Level Validation of Web Applications.
	Created VBScript Modules to manage and monitor the    security aspects of Web Application Server. (Windows 2000 Advance Server/ Windows Server 2003)  
	Was Responsible for Data Migration and backup of data groups from one server to another.(SQL Server 2000)                                         
	Created Advanced SQL stored procedures to generate reports for Sales Organization. 
	Responsible for diagnosing and correcting dial-up networking and RAS issues.
